name: Borden (United States)
description: Red field with a narrow white stripe near the top and bottom, charged with three torches from the Indiana state flag, the central one overlaid by the town seal reading A Small Town With A Big Future and BORDEN.
history: Borden is a town in Wood Township, Clark County, Indiana.

features.role: three torches with blue and white handles, after the state flag
